title: Activity content, format version 2
description: Editable activity format. Every exercise (step) owns its skills; answer keys live only in each step's `key`; what the child sees lives in `config`. The top-level `skills` list is derived from the exercises and rewritten by the server on every save. See docs/activity-format-v2.md. Images (format 2, additive): a step, an option, a match item or a sequence item may carry `image` = {asset, alt}; see docs/activity-format-v2.md.

authoring.description: Editor-only notes. Never sent to the app.

enabled.description: false hides the exercise from children and from scoring without deleting it (ids stay stable).

title.description: Short label for editors and lists; not shown to the child.

mode.description: auto = the server scores the answer; none = never scored; parent_rubric = a parent rates it (parent_checklist only). Omitted = the default for the type.

points.description: Reserved; not used by the scorer yet.

partial_credit.description: multi_choice: (right - wrong) / total correct, floored at 0.

items.description: A skill this exercise gives evidence for. weight (0..1] scales how much this exercise counts for that skill.

incorrect.description: Reserved: message after a wrong answer (not shown by the app yet).
